why: Batch 53, 53.4 follow-up (Dan 11:10, jobs/c3/batch53.yaml next_1110 item 4): attention in blocks 19 + 26 blocked to the span from the bridge word to the scene's end vs a control span of the same length; no prediction

arm_text.both: (iii) of 53.4, rerun here: blocks 19 and 26, source = the bridge word
arm_text.span: blocks 19 and 26: every position after the scene's last token cannot attend to any position from the bridge word through the scene's last token

blocking: knockout.knock_out (mode value) via x47_edges.forward: in the arm's blocks, every position after the source has its logits to the source at -inf in every head; uncached forwards
read: X0's chat read (the org prompt with a digit's space token appended; top token over the vocabulary; switch = the alt answer's first token)

rule: "the pointer is read by attention after the Mamba state spreads it" if the span cuts the lookup's switches by >= 0.6 and the control by <= 0.15; else as 53.4.
as_computed: cut(x) = 1 - S_x / S_whole on the lookup (53.4's), S_x = the share of the scenes kept whose lookup switches under the whole change with arm x's block, S_whole = the same with no block, all in this run's forwards; point estimates decide, EPS 1e-09 at the bars. "else as 53.4": 53.4's labels applied to the span arm: its (iv) clause "not through attention at the bridge" if the span cuts < 0.3 (the Mamba state carries it), else "in between" (the per-block clauses (i) / (ii) have no span arm). The span's destinations are every position after the scene's last token (knock_out needs disjoint sources and destinations, so attention inside the span is as is), the same for the control. the control span: as many tokens as the bridge-to-scene-end span, inside the scene before the bridge word (from the scene's first token to the token before the bridge word; never the bridge-to-end span, never the question, never position 0), its start drawn per scene among the starts that fit (random.Random('x53_attnspan|5348|<scene>')); a scene where no such span fits is dropped from the rule and counted (its span arm read beside); the destinations are the span arm's (every position after the scene's last token: the question and the read), so the two arms differ only in the keys blocked. S_whole = 0: not tested; X0's validity reported, not a gate. 53.4's (iii) and (v) from its committed verdict beside, and (iii) rerun here
